repeatBoundary.interpretation: 479 and512 are source evidence counts, not approved master-art counts or permissions to merge expression IDs. Every original592 position remains required. All168 source files and all cross-resource rasters are distinct.
repeatBoundary.reusePolicy: Only exact repeated states within the same source expression may share its own newly painted raster; preserve all original indices, geometries and offsets. A source repeated-raster bob must not be cancelled by re-registering every frame to one logical point.

batches.title: 道具与符号
batches.implementationApproach: 先逐项匹配现有原创道具；缺少同义画稿的编号独立补画。保留心裂、蒸汽、烛火、手势等动作，不用静态道具覆盖动画。

batches.title: 动物、双人关系与人物
batches.implementationApproach: 逐编号设计自有角色和姿态；替换原企鹅及人物身份，090保留双角色与浮心关系。不得用同一正面头像填满。

batches.title: 圆耳24套与同号member缩略图
batches.implementationApproach: 24种眼口/附加物独立设计；每种保留原6位，member由同号自有表情母稿另作小尺寸导出。二者不是源别名。

batches.title: 粉色无耳脸24套
batches.implementationApproach: 为24种表情保留独立眼口、红心、眼泪、白气、帽子及动作；逐位重绘。

batches.title: 黄脸36套与两种手部动作
batches.implementationApproach: 逐表情制作；长动作059/067/074/077/083单列相位表，保留嘴形、手势、汗珠、转头和爆散过程。

globalRisks: Stored frame order is proven; original playback timing, frame rate, loops, native branch and expression labels are not proven. Do not collapse repeated entries or invent timing.
Declared canvas is source metadata, not a verified runtime viewport. Do not automatically trim source geometry to it.
Most small expressions are19–20 pixels, large round-ear frames about37×31, member about26×20. Require native1× and enlarged3× static checks; a large master preview alone is insufficient.
Original character/letter/item Alpha is artwork, not a reusable functional mask. Replacement faces, tears, hearts, gestures and shapes need own Alpha.
Member semantic pairings are visually observed, not pixel/file aliases. Preserve24 distinct source paths and each original geometry.
Source descriptions are visible-shape classifications. Unknown interpretations such as078 text and098 golden symbol remain explicit.
No public source PNG is included in this plan; no new face placeholder, source alias, native patch or runtime installation is produced.
